reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions; there was no existing helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The linked-account query and error are defined once; each link function only passes its provider name.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers it serves; accounts/link.ts, which already holds link-time DB helpers like findOrCreateBank, would also have been a natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: A small, well-named guard called first in every link path, so the rule and its upgrading-account exemption are easy to find and change.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
